newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Multi-Usage in Vietnam road talks.
newsitem.headline: Multi-Usage in Vietnam road talks.

text.p: Multi-Usage Holdings Bhd said on Friday it has entered into direct talks with Vietnam authorities on a privatisation project for an inner belt ring road in Ho Chi Minh City.
In a statement, the company said the project would involve the building, operation and transfer of the inner city-suburbs route in the Vietnamese city, with a concession period of 35 years.
The company is in talks with the Ministry of Public Works and Communications for the project.
The route is about 15 km long and includes a 500 meter bridge. Initial project cost is estimated at $200 million.
Multi-Usage said it is working on the terms of the agreement and is preparing a final report to be submitted to the city committee for approval.
